project_info.title: Playful golden-hour walk at Tamsui River

prompt.main_subject: An adult Taiwanese woman with long softly wavy dark hair, clear natural makeup, and a beige knit cardigan walking along the Tamsui riverside.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 handheld companion POV follows the woman on a riverside path, pans to the golden river and Lover's Bridge, then returns for the soft-serve gag.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Golden-hour side and backlight with warm rim light, sparkling water, natural river ambience, slight handheld shake, and candid travel atmosphere.

technical_specs.duration_pacing: 15-second storyboard pacing; use as narrative timing, not an API duration parameter.
technical_specs.camera: Handheld 24mm-equivalent companion POV with no perspective switch and a smooth pan to the river.
technical_specs.audio: Natural dialogue and street ambience; no subtitles, logo, or watermark.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: 15-second vertical 9:16 film-feel video with natural grain on a Taipei Tamsui River bank walking path at golden sunset, with sparkling river surface and the silhouette of Lover's Bridge in the distance. Main character is an adult Taiwanese woman with long slightly wavy dark hair, beige knitted cardigan, and clear natural makeup. Use a handheld companion POV follow shot with slight lens shake and no perspective switch. From 0-4 seconds, she walks two steps ahead, turns with mock impatience, presses down windblown hair, and gestures to keep up, saying, "Hey, walk faster! You are dragging your feet!" Sunset side-backlight outlines her cheek and hair. From 4-8 seconds, she stops to look toward the river; the lens smoothly pans to the sunset panorama, sparkling waves, and bridge silhouette, then returns to her smiling face as she says, "Wow, look at this light!" From 8-10 seconds, she notices a roadside stall and leads the camera forward with natural street ambience. From 10-13 seconds, holding a tall Tamsui soft serve, she offers it toward the lens, takes the first bite herself, laughs, and says, "Just kidding!" From 13-15 seconds, she notices cream on her nose, pauses, and laughs toward the lens. No text, subtitles, logo, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, minor, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed
